XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_DICE.title: Dice
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_DICE.description: The dice you hold, each showing 1-6, up to 5 (including temporary dice). Every die is rolled again at the start of each turn.
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_TEMP_DICE.title: Temporary Dice
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_TEMP_DICE.description: Dice that vanish when the enemies' turn ends. They show a random value when gained.
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_TOTAL_DICE.title: Total Dice
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_TOTAL_DICE.description: The sum of the values of all your dice.
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_PLEDGE.title: Pledge
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_PLEDGE.description: Temporarily lose a die for X turns; it returns with a random value at the start of the Xth turn (nothing happens if you are full). Cards that pledge cannot be played without enough dice. A pledged temporary die simply vanishes.
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_BET_HIGH.title: Bet High
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_BET_HIGH.description: Reroll a die. It succeeds if the new value is greater than the old one (a tie fails).
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_REROLL.title: Reroll
XIAO_TU_KEYWORD_REROLL.description: Roll a die again, completely at random. The automatic roll at the start of the turn is not a reroll.
